description: Creates a social publishing automation that posts to the team's connected channels on a schedule. Use when the user wants to auto-post tips, clips or a workout video daily, weekly or once. Not for posting right now (create, then use run_social_automation_now). Returns the new automation's ID, saved as off (draft); turn it on with set_social_automation_state. Needs a plan that includes publishing automations.

allowed_drop_source_types.description: Video posts only: which library sources a run may pick from. exercise = single exercise clip, exerciseCollection = exercise group, workout = workout, workoutCollection = program. Empty or omitted = all.

allowed_kinds.description: For random_ready and ai_insights: post types a run may use. clip = video from a library item; tip, fact, myth_fact (myth vs fact), insight (team stats), trend, quote, offer = AI-written image posts. Omitted = video clips only.

channel_presets.description: Every format to publish to, 1 to 20; must include primary_channel_preset. Same values as primary_channel_preset, e.g. ["ig_reels", "tiktok"]. Defaults to just primary_channel_preset.

drop_id.description: Post to publish when source_mode is manual_fixed. Get it from list_team_drops or create_drop.

export_aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio to publish: "9:16" vertical, "1:1" square, "16:9" landscape. Omit to use the format default.

export_duration_seconds.description: Clip length to publish, in seconds: 15, 30 or 60. Omit to use the format default.

locale.description: workout_full_video only: language of the workout export to post, e.g. "en-US". Omit for the default export.

name.description: Automation name shown in Teams, up to 200 characters, e.g. "Weekly tips".

next_run_at.description: First (next) run time; the run goes out at the top of the hour at or after it, as ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-12-01T09:00:00Z" or "2026-12-01T09:00:00+01:00".

primary_channel_preset.description: Main format; its copy is used for the post. ig_reels = Instagram Reel, ig_stories = Instagram Story, ig_carousel = Instagram square video, tiktok = TikTok, yt_shorts = YouTube Short, fb_reels = Facebook Reel, yt_longform = YouTube long-form video (video posts only); ig_post = Instagram feed image post (image posts only); fb_post, linkedin_post, threads_post = feed posts (video or image).

publish_asset_type.description: What the automation posts: social_drop = ready social posts (drops); workout_full_video = a workout's full exported video. Defaults to social_drop.

ready_drop_pick.description: For random_ready and ai_insights: random = random among the 80 most recently updated ready posts; latest = the newest ready post. Posts published in the last 30 days are skipped. Defaults to random.

repeat_mode.description: How often it runs: once, daily, weekly, biweekly (every 2 weeks) or monthly, starting at next_run_at.

repeat_until.description: Last day the automation may run, as ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-12-01T09:00:00Z" or "2026-12-01T09:00:00+01:00".

source_mode.description: How each run picks a post: manual_fixed = always the one post in drop_id; random_ready = shuffle among ready posts; ai_insights = AI picks the post that fits your Brand Kit mix and analytics. Required for social_drop automations, e.g. "ai_insights".

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone that keeps the run at the same local time, e.g. "Europe/London". Omit to keep the UTC time.

workout_id.description: Workout whose full exported video to publish, for publish_asset_type workout_full_video. Get it from list_team_workouts; the workout needs a finished video export.
